paper.title_en: Anisotropies in the PTA gravitational wave background: what can they teach us about supermassive black hole binaries?
paper.abstract_en: The gravitational wave background detected by pulsar timing arrays is sourced by a finite population of supermassive black hole binaries, and is therefore anisotropic. We ask what measuring that anisotropy can teach us about the population, using models that span a wide range of effective source counts, all normalized to the measured background amplitude. We find four things. First, the expected anisotropy is produced by the single brightest binary: a dipole at the level of the published NANOGrav 95% upper limit would require one source to supply about 60% of the power in the band. Second, no model that also reproduces the measured strain spectrum contains a source that bright. In every case the loudest binary stays below the NANOGrav continuous-wave upper limit at every frequency it covers, consistent with the joint search of the 15-year data, which finds no resolved source. Third, because the anisotropy is produced by one source, compressing the sky to an angular power spectrum discards the phase information that locates it. Such a search is never more sensitive than looking for the source directly, and is strictly worse once more than a dipole is kept. Fourth, the published upper limits on the angular power spectrum therefore reflect the analysis prior rather than the data: they coincide with the 95th percentile of the prior induced by the square-root spherical harmonic basis adopted in the analysis. What does constrain the population today is the shape of the strain spectrum. Rare, bright sources depress the median spectrum below its mean, and fitting the measured spectrum already disfavors mass functions dominated by binaries above about 10^10 solar masses.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究脉冲星计时阵列引力波背景的各向异性，属于PTA主题，有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列引力波背景的各向异性：它们能告诉我们关于超大质量黑洞双星的什么？
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景由有限数量的超大质量黑洞双星产生，因此是各向异性的。我们探讨测量这种各向异性能告诉我们关于该群体的哪些信息，使用涵盖广泛有效源计数的模型，所有模型都归一化到测量的背景振幅。我们发现了四点。第一，预期的各向异性由单个最亮的双星产生：偶极子达到已发表的NANOGrav 95%上限水平，需要约60%的波段功率来自一个源。第二，没有模型能同时重现测量的应变谱并包含如此亮的源。在每种情况下，最响亮的双星在其覆盖的每个频率上都低于NANOGrav连续波上限，这与对15年数据的联合搜索一致，该搜索未发现可分辨的源。第三，由于各向异性由一个源产生，将天空压缩到角功率谱会丢弃定位它的相位信息。这种搜索永远不会比直接寻找源更敏感，而且一旦保留超过偶极子的部分，效果就更差。第四，因此已发表的角功率谱上限反映了分析先验而非数据：它们与采用平方根球谐基分析所得的95%先验分位数一致。今天真正约束群体的是应变谱的形状。罕见而明亮的源使中位频谱低于其均值，而拟合测量的频谱已经不利于由大约10^10太阳质量以上的双星主导的质量函数。
